world.name: Equal Earth
world.reason: It keeps area and the shapes look natural.

hemisphere.name: Lambert azimuthal equal-area
hemisphere.reason: It keeps area around one centre point.

mid-latitude band.name: Albers equal-area conic
mid-latitude band.reason: A cone with two standard parallels keeps area across a wide band.

polar.name: Lambert azimuthal equal-area (polar)
polar.reason: It keeps area around the pole.

local strip.name: Lambert azimuthal equal-area
local strip.reason: Over a small area it keeps area with little shape error.

one point.name: Lambert azimuthal equal-area
one point.reason: It keeps area and centres the map on the point.

world.name: Mercator
world.reason: It keeps angles everywhere, but area grows toward the poles.

hemisphere.name: Stereographic
hemisphere.reason: It keeps angles and circles over a hemisphere.

mid-latitude band.name: Lambert conformal conic
mid-latitude band.reason: A cone with two standard parallels keeps angles across a wide band.

polar.name: Polar stereographic
polar.reason: It keeps angles around the pole.

local strip.name: Transverse Mercator (UTM)
local strip.reason: A cylinder along one meridian keeps angles in a narrow strip.

one point.name: Stereographic
one point.reason: It keeps angles around the point.

world.name: Azimuthal equidistant
world.reason: Distances from the centre are true over the whole world.

hemisphere.name: Azimuthal equidistant
hemisphere.reason: Distances from the centre are true.

mid-latitude band.name: Equidistant conic
mid-latitude band.reason: Distances along the meridians are true.

polar.name: Polar azimuthal equidistant
polar.reason: Distances from the pole are true.

local strip.name: Cassini (transverse equirectangular)
local strip.reason: Distances along the strip centre line are true.

one point.name: Azimuthal equidistant
one point.reason: Distances and directions from the point are true.

world.name: Winkel tripel
world.reason: It shares the error between area and angles.

hemisphere.name: Orthographic
hemisphere.reason: It shows the globe as seen from far away.

mid-latitude band.name: Equidistant conic
mid-latitude band.reason: It keeps area and angle errors small in a band.

polar.name: Polar azimuthal equidistant
polar.reason: It keeps area and angle errors moderate around the pole.

local strip.name: Transverse Mercator
local strip.reason: In a narrow strip every error is small.

one point.name: Orthographic
one point.reason: It shows the area round the point as seen from space.
